title: Wonderlands×Showtime Chapter1 Episode19 The Path to the Greatest Show

meta.Episode: Episode19 — The Path to the Greatest Show

rows.Speaker: Ex-Classmate
rows.Line:
What the... I'm not doing something that dumb.
Don't you have any better ideas?

rows.Speaker: Ex-Classmate
rows.Line: Are you having a laugh trying to get us hurt?

rows.Speaker: Ex-Classmate
rows.Line: I've had enough of you and your stupid shows.
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What is this, an ambush? I'm sorry, but I'm not changing my mind.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I need to show you something.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Whatever it is, it won't make a difference.
Like I said, I don't want to stage shows with you ever agai—

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Now! I got him!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uh... Here!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What are you doing, Emu? And you too, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Do it, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Good job! Rui, I'm going to show you...my true feelings!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You brought me here again?
bgm_area00004

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone!
Tonight we have a special performance guaranteed to put a smile on your face♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Are you ready to put on a good show for the audience?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I couldn't be more ready!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Once upon a time, there was an eccentric traveling theater troupe♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There was an attention-craving showman, a stubborn clown, and a songstress too shy to sing in front of people!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The oddball group staged many shows, but they never managed to attract an audience!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then one day, as they were traveling through a forest, they encountered an alchemist who was performing a show all alone.

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line:
“What an incredible performance!
If you joined us, our troupe would make a name for itself at last!”

rows.Speaker: Alchemist
rows.Line: “Who are you?”

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line: “I am a showman, and I could use your help to put on wonderful shows!”

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line: “I promise that our spectacles will be a joy to see and a joy to perform in!”

rows.Speaker: Alchemist
rows.Line:
“You wish to make shows with me?
I see. I suppose I could help you out a little.”

rows.Speaker: Clown
rows.Line: “Yaaay! Welcome to our troupe!”

rows.Speaker: Songstress
rows.Line: “But will I...find the courage to sing?”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The alchemist made a doll for the shy songstress, which carried her voice even as she hid behind the stage.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: He also constructed various contraptions such as a machine which could produce lightning, a stage with jets of air, and even an enormous dragon!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alas, their performance came to an abrupt end when the singing doll broke in the middle of it!

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line: “What a shameful fiasco! It's all your fault!”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The showman was so overwhelmed with disappointment that he blamed the rest of the troupe, and their previous joy and excitement turned to sorrow.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They all left, each going their own way.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The showman suddenly felt very lonely. He remembered how much he enjoyed preparing the show with the rest of the troupe...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: His thoughts were interrupted by the appearance of a cute fairy.

rows.Speaker: Fairy
rows.Line:
“Why were you making shows?
Wasn't it because you wanted to make people happy?”

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line: “How could I have forgotten...”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The showman remembered the first time he saw a theatrical performance, and regretted the way he treated his troupe members.

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line: “I've always wanted to become a star like the actors in the first show I saw. I wanted to be a star so that I too could make people as happy as I was then.”

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line: “It was very important to me, but I forgot it along the way. I shall never forget it again!”

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line:
“What I want is to make people smile.
I want to perform with my troupe again!”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The showman sincerely apologized to the rest of the troupe and they agreed to come back...all except the alchemist, who didn't believe him.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The alchemist was convinced that the showman didn't care so much about theater, as about becoming a star.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yet, the showman didn't want to give up his hopes of convincing the alchemist to return. He resolved to try a different approach...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
He made a play just for the alchemist.
After the passionate performance, he spoke to him.

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line:
“It's true that it's my dream to become a star.
A star who brings joy to everyone!”

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line: “To me, a star is someone who delights the audience as much as his fellow performers with the most wonderful shows!”

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line: “Please, believe me this time! With our next show we can spread joy to everyone around us!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Won't you join my troupe again?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What do you think the alchemist said?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What do I think? This is your role...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
No, I am just a stand-in.
How the play goes from here has yet to be decided.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Did you think you could express your feelings better through a performance?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, as a matter of fact I did!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Theater has given me so much. I've seen shows which stirred my feelings, shows that filled me with enthusiasm! They made me dream of starring in shows like that myself!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's why my feelings can be communicated most clearly through a show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui! Let's make shows together again! Please!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: ...Heh.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Wonderful shows...which delight both the audience and the performers, hmm? I like the sound of that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But a passionate monologue alone isn't enough to move an audience.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's think of how to make your performance more expressive, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Do you mean...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You mean...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, do not misunderstand.
I am not Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I am the alchemist.
